# Security policy

This repository's security policy — what is in scope, how a report is handled,
and which versions are supported — lives in the repository root:
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Reports that could expose private duty plan or itinerary data go through this
repository's private vulnerability reporting, and nowhere else:

<https://github.com/duty2cal/duty2cal/security/advisories/new>

(Security tab → **Report a vulnerability**.) Never open a public issue for such
a report, and never attach a real duty plan, a calendar converted from one, or a
personal itinerary — neither to an issue nor to a pull request.
